meta.name: Battleship Potemkin
meta.description: In the midst of the Russian Revolution of 1905, the crew of the battleship Potemkin revolt against the brutal, tyrannical regime of the vessel's officers. The resulting street demonstration in Odessa brings on a police massacre.
meta.slogan: Revolution is the only lawful, equal, effectual war. It was in Russia that this war was declared and begun.
